Name: Prismatic Mr. Qi
Author: Tooma8
Description:
This is my first attempt at making a SMAPI mod/content pack for Stardew Valley. It lets you edit Mr. Qi's skin color to 6 different colors. It also has a option for a randomized skin color each day.

Configuration:
"QiColor" - Let's you choose Mr. Qi's skin color
Options:
"Blue" (vanilla)
"Red"
"Orange"
"Yellow"
"Green"
"Purple"

"RandomColor" - Let's you toggle daily randomized skin color
Options:
"On"
"Off"

You can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu [/url]for easier configuration.

Please let me know if you find any problems!

Character and portrait edits created by me in PixieEngine
